question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing sweeper, Bob is playing center midfielder, Claire is playing right winger, Dave is playing left midfielder, and Eve is playing right back.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Dave and Alice trade positions. Then, Eve and Dave trade positions. Then, Claire and Alice trade positions. Then, Dave and Alice trade positions. Finally, Dave and Claire trade positions. At the end of the match, Alice is playing
Options:
(A) sweeper
(B) center midfielder
(C) right winger
(D) left midfielder
(E) right back
solution:
Each row lists positions in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve.
Initial: sweeper, center midfielder, right winger, left midfielder, right back
1. Dave ↔ Alice: left midfielder, center midfielder, right winger, sweeper, right back
2. Eve ↔ Dave: left midfielder, center midfielder, right winger, right back, sweeper
3. Claire ↔ Alice: right winger, center midfielder, left midfielder, right back, sweeper
4. Dave ↔ Alice: right back, center midfielder, left midfielder, right winger, sweeper
5. Dave ↔ Claire: right back, center midfielder, right winger, left midfielder, sweeper
Alice plays right back, option (E).
Final answer: (E)
